items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And then Prince played with my daddy several times.

ctx.x: You know, you forgot to tell us about Tom Albert. You were talking about Tom Albert.

Tom Albert, he was a great guy. He used to come over to see my daddy. And my daddy, he heard about him through some trauma. And Tom wanted to play and he told me my daddy, I can't think of his name. And then Prince played with my daddy several times. And it got so Prince he couldn't come over there anymore. So he referred Tom Albert to my daddy. Tom Albert, he come over and he and my daddy got to be personal friends. Sometimes my daddy didn't have any music to play. Well, the Gulf Coast, it used to be a great…
